description: Lists the files under a path of a public GitHub repository (at a commit sha) or npm package (at a version whose tarball matched the registry's sha512), with type, size and git blob id per file. Pages with offset/limit (at most 1000 entries and about 1 MB per page; truncated:true when the byte bound ended a page); total names the full count and next_offset the next page. Every answer, an error included, carries a pauhu-library-receipt/2 in structuredContent.receipt and as a trailing "receipt: {...}" text line; library_verify checks a receipt.

package.description: npm package name, e.g. source-map-js or @scope/name. Give this or repo.

ref.description: Branch, tag or 40-hex commit sha (default HEAD). It is resolved to a commit sha first; the read is at that sha.

repo.description: GitHub repository as owner/name, e.g. nodejs/node. Give this or package.

version.description: npm version or dist-tag (default latest); the tarball is checked against the registry's sha512 integrity.

name: code_list
title: List files of a repository or package at an exact identity
